(async () => { await window.raid.fresh(); await window.raid.hold(true); await window.raid.start(11, 0); await window.raid.taught(); await window.raid.bot(5); await window.raid.skip(2); await window.raid.plan(); await window.raid.skip(2); return await 'planning'; })()

(async () => {const id = await window.raid.give('kettle', 2); await window.raid.item('thorn'); await window.raid.item('plume'); await window.raid.item('chestnut'); await window.raid.item('glowcap'); window.raid.skip(1.2); return 'kettle ' + id})()
(()=>{const p = window.raid.party().find(p => p.stars === 1 && p.on === 'board'); window.raid.tap(p.id); window.raid.skip(0.2); return 'one star: ' + p.kind})()
(()=>{window.raid.drop(); const p = window.raid.party().find(p => p.kind === 'kettle'); window.raid.tap(p.id); window.raid.skip(0.2); return 'two stars: ' + p.kind})()

(()=>{window.raid.drop(); const p = window.raid.party().find(p => p.on === 'board'); window.raid.hand(0, p.id); window.raid.hand(0, p.id); window.raid.skip(0.6); window.raid.tap(p.id); window.raid.skip(0.2); return 'holding: ' + p.kind})()
(async () => { await window.raid.drop(); await window.raid.offer(1, 'cindernewt'); await window.raid.skip(0.3); return await 'stall'; })()
(window.raid.skip(0.12), 'tapped a trait: kept card ' + !!document.querySelector('.k-info.pinned') + ', lit offers ' + document.querySelectorAll('.offer.tlit').length)
